_comment: Korea Customs Service open-API endpoints (data.go.kr). All require a free
service key: register at https://www.data.go.kr (instant, no cost), request
use of each dataset (auto-approved), then set env var DATA_GO_KR_API_KEY
Flash 10-day datasets (verified 2026-08-14 from the English dataset pages):
Both: XML, unit thousand USD, history from 2016-01, published on the 11th
semiconductors, steel, cars, petroleum products, wireless devices, ships,
auto parts, computer peripherals, precision instruments, home appliances.
Portal view of the same numbers: https://tradedata.go.kr
_hs_codes_note: Used only by the monthly item-trade API path (korea_customs.py), which
requires DATA_GO_KR_API_KEY. The no-key tradedata.go.kr flash feed uses
KCS's own fixed 10-category breakdown and ignores these codes, so the
photonics entries below are inert until a service key is configured.

hs_codes.8479: Machines with individual functions (incl. industrial robots ex 8479.50)
hs_codes.8541: Photosensitive semiconductor devices - laser diodes, photodiodes, LEDs
hs_codes.8517: Transmission apparatus for networks (incl. optical transceivers, 8517.62)
hs_codes.9001: Optical fibres, fibre bundles and cables
